newsitem.title: UK: Eadie Holdings falls after profits warning.
newsitem.headline: Eadie Holdings falls after profits warning.

text.p: Shares in healthcare equipment manufacturer and distributor Eadie Holdings dropped sharply on Thursday, after the company said profits would fall short of expectations in the current year following an orders slowdown and rescheduling of some orders into next year.
The company said that several operations had failed to show the traditional upturn after the summer shutdowns.
Shares in Eadie were 6-1/2p lower at 11-1/2p, a fall of 36 percent, in early trading.
A restructuring charge of 0.5 million stg and other non-recurring costs had also hit profits, which it said would not exceed first half levels in the second half.
